thread.title: Stock Market Today: Stocks Jump Early Monday, But Trim Gains; Some Leaders Turn Red

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Stock Market Today: Stocks Jump Early Monday, But Trim Gains; Some Leaders Turn Red
text:
The major market averages were squarely higher in early trade Monday, but were off their opening highs. Top stock Amazon.com ( AMZN ) rallied more than 1% in the stock market today , as it tried to recover a portion of last week's heavy loss.
X The Nasdaq rose 1.1%, while the S&P 500 and   average held gains of 1.1% and 1.3%, respectively. Still, the major indexes still have a lot of work ahead of them to make up for last week's damage. Last week's action left the market in correction , so investors should mostly be in wait-and-see mode.
Within the Dow industrials — of which only one was trading in negative territory — Cisco Systems ( CSCO ) paced the advancers with an over-3% rise. The networking giant is moving back above its 50-day line with strong relative strength .
Meanwhile, Apple ( AAPL ) followed through on Friday's upside reversal with a 2.5% gain. Shares are trying to get back above their long-term 200-day moving average line.
FANG stocks were mostly in rally mode early Monday, as they looked to snap back from last week's steep sell-offs. Leading the way were Amazon.com and video streamer Netflix ( NFLX ) with gains of 1.5% and 2.1%, respectively. The e-commerce giant neared its 50-day line Friday before rallying sharply off its lows.
Shares of Netflix remain sharply extended from their previous 204.48 flat-base entry despite a loss of nearly 7% last week.
Conversely, Facebook ( FB ) reversed from early gains to fall almost 1%. The stock is trying to recover back above its 50-day line, which it gave up last week in heavy volume.
Meanwhile, Nvidia ( NVDA ) tried to follow up Friday's earnings-related advance with a solid gain, but turned 0.5% lower. The stock has been volatile since a Jan. 8 breakout above a 218.77 cup-base entry within a difficult market environment. Still the stock is only about 8% off its 52-week high, while its relative strength line has been hitting new highs, signifying strong outperformance of the general market.
Chinese e-commerce companies Alibaba ( BABA ) and JD.com ( JD ) moved up about 2% apiece before trimming those gains. Alibaba remains below its 50-day line after a failed breakout above a 191.85 cup-base buy point, while JD was trying to recover its 50-day line amid its own failed breakout above a 47.50 cup-with-handle entry.
Inside the IBD 50 , Arista Networks ( ANET ) jumped about 3% to move within inches of a new 52-week high early Monday. The stock has done a tremendous job of holding up over the last week. Shares have once again found support at their 10-week line after a breakout above a 245.75 buy point.
Elsewhere, Stamps.com ( STMP ) declined about 10% to fall through its 200-day line. The stock had been forming a cup-shaped base, but that formation has been broken amid the market's sharp fall.
